description: This file defines the CompilationErrors trait in the org.apache.spark.sql.errors package, providing various methods to generate AnalysisException instances for different compilation error scenarios within Spark SQL.

classes.name: CompilationErrors
classes.description: A trait providing methods to create AnalysisException instances for various compilation errors in Spark SQL.

methods.name: ambiguousColumnOrFieldError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for ambiguous column or field errors.

methods.name: columnNotFoundError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when a column is not found.

methods.name: descriptorParseError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for protobuf descriptor parse errors.

methods.name: describeJsonNotExtendedError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when JSON description is not extended.

methods.name: describeColJsonUnsupportedError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for unsupported JSON feature in table column description.

methods.name: cannotFindDescriptorFileError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when protobuf descriptor file is not found.

methods.name: usingUntypedScalaUDFError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for untyped Scala UDF errors.

methods.name: invalidBoundaryStartError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for invalid boundary start value.

methods.name: invalidBoundaryEndError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for invalid boundary end value.

methods.name: invalidSaveModeError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for invalid save mode.

methods.name: sortByWithoutBucketingError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for sortBy without bucketing.

methods.name: bucketByUnsupportedByOperationError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for unsupported bucketBy operation.

methods.name: bucketByAndSortByUnsupportedByOperationError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for unsupported combination of bucketBy and sortBy.

methods.name: operationNotSupportPartitioningError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for unsupported partitioning operation.

methods.name: operationNotSupportClusteringError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException for unsupported clustering operation.

methods.name: clusterByWithPartitionedBy
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when clusterBy is used with partitionedBy.

methods.name: clusterByWithBucketing
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when clusterBy is used with bucketing.

methods.name: cannotModifyValueOfStaticConfigError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when attempting to modify static configuration.

methods.name: cannotModifyValueOfSparkConfigError
methods.description: Creates an AnalysisException when attempting to modify Spark configuration.
